instructions: This paper has three sections. Answer ALL questions in Sections A and B, and any ONE question in Section C.
Write your answers in the answer booklet provided.

sections.title: Section A
sections.instructions: Answer ALL questions. Circle the correct option.

questions.text: Which SQL clause filters groups after aggregation?
questions.explanation: HAVING is applied after GROUP BY; WHERE filters rows before grouping.

questions.text: Which normal form removes transitive dependencies?
A primary key must be unique and…
A university keeps records of students, courses and lecturers.
points: A student enrols in one or more courses.
Each course is taught by exactly one lecturer.
A lecturer may teach several courses.

parts.text: Draw an ER diagram that captures the constraints above.
Map your ER diagram to relational schemas, showing primary and foreign keys.
parts.model_answer: Student(student_id, name); Course(course_id, title, lecturer_id FK); Lecturer(lecturer_id, name); Enrolment(student_id FK, course_id FK) with a composite primary key.

questions.text: Explain why a deadlock can occur under two-phase locking, giving an example schedule.
questions.model_answer: Two transactions each hold a lock the other needs and wait forever for it to be released.
